title: C¹ maps on open sets send Lebesgue-null sets to H^m-null sets (Luzin N property)
statement: Let m, P ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^m open, ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P C¹ on V, and Z ⊆ V with L^m(Z) = 0, where L^m = volume on Euclid m. Then H^m(ψ(Z)) = 0, where H^m = μHE[m] is the normalized m-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (V Z : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → Z ⊆ V → volume Z = 0 → μHE[m] (ψ '' Z) = 0
